name: print-social-future-of-fashion-posts-black-neon-purple-cyber-illustration
title: 'The Future of Fashion' pack in black with neon purple-cyan cyber illustration and holographic accessories
whatItIs: Four black square posts with a glowing purple-cyan illustrated woman with a metallic zipper jacket, a starfield backdrop, thin corner frame lines, and headlines ('The Future of Fashion', 'Accessorize Your Way to the Future', 'Glow Like a Celestial Goddess', 'Bold and Edgy Outfits') with empty 'Image here' placeholder frames.
whatItMeans: Bold and otherworldly; neon-lit cyber illustration makes futuristic fashion feel like it belongs in a sci-fi universe.
techniques: Illustrate a figure with neon rim lighting for a glowing effect.
Use thin corner frame lines to suggest a HUD or interface.
Leave labelled placeholder frames for swappable product photos.

vocabulary.definition: Light outlining a subject's edge, often used for a glowing effect.
Thin corner lines suggesting a heads-up display interface.
